question: Can the unmodified native Fervor and Smolder role chains be specified, component-intervened and distinguished without the two failed bulk catalogues or a new primitive?
authority: #421 direct-native continuation; candidate-decision-20260909/DECISION.json at8c7277da. Owner permits author self-review, not independent confirmation.
factorial: mask=-1 stock;0 wrapper off;1 producer component off;2 consumer amplification off;3 both off. Interventions only on nominated aspect. Costs, Exhaust, hit topology, hooks, death and RNG retain native semantics.

fervor.scope: Dusk; intrinsic Strength remains shared native law, not a new aspect-exclusive primitive
fervor.producer: empower; cost1 Power consumed; +2/+3 player str
fervor.mediator: visible numeric player str, additive, not consumed per hit/action, reset at new combat
fervor.consumer: flurry cost1 Attack; 3 sequential hits of2/3 base, each consults str; one card lifecycle and chip settlement
fervor.payoff: per-hit native weak/vulnerable floors, multiplication, Block and health/death/thorns guards; no scalar collapse to one hit
fervor.intervention: remove Empower status only; remove str from hit2+ only while preserving all hits and one base contribution
fervor.ideal_marginal_interaction: (3-1)*s =4/6 on plain first consumer; not a universal HP formula under clipping/rounding/death
fervor.acquisition: both in native uncommon pool without deed/reveal requirements; actual offer and policy support unproved

smolder.scope: Ash; source add_status_enemy poison is blocked on core Dusk
smolder.producer: venomStrike cost1 Attack; damage4/6 then add4/5 poison only to surviving target
smolder.mediator: visible target poison; additive source; Catalyst multiplies2/3; next enemy phase applies poison then decrements; native transfer on death/Shatter
smolder.consumer: catalyst cost1 targeted Skill; positive-stock multiplier; Exhaust, +1 Ember and optional Branch draw remain
smolder.payoff: deferred HP loss, not immediate damage; record source hit separately; target death and jump can change subsequent path
smolder.intervention: remove only source poison component; remove only multiplier body, retaining native lifecycle and resource costs
smolder.ideal_marginal_interaction: p*(m-1)=4/10 additional stock on plain surviving source target, observed through next native enemy phase
smolder.acquisition: source native common; Catalyst native rare with poolWave3 reveal, no deed injection; population support unproved

claims: Full stock/off future-state, alias, queue and returned-event equality
Other-aspect exact-null for all component masks
Dormant amplifier exact-null with empty mediator; no claim source erasure is null when source is present
Plain source-by-amplifier algebra with nominal/actual/deferred units kept separate
Retarget distinguishes player memory from target memory; repeated consumer retains str but exhausts Catalyst instances
Full source/card/cost/reset/pool mapping, no new primitive from relabel
Guarded native composition, not equivalence to multiple separately played cards or a full historical quotient
stopping: Any identity/parity/coverage failure is invalid measurement, preserve capture and fix only implementation under unchanged inputs. Algebra/structural counterexample is a failed specific claim, no threshold rescue. No new population or product candidate is authorised solely by finite cases.
limits: Constructed states and one fixture RNG are not natural reachability or independent samples
Underlying native laws already exist; distinction from one-bit extra-payoff contract does not erase its native background or prove formal novelty
Complete closed/admitted-family quotient, policy viability, descriptor, independent confirmation and P9 remain separate
Original Hand and both whole-catalogue negatives remain unchanged; no v25 or old panel replay
